scenes.title: Care and its surroundings
lines: The Illness Machine examines why care can help while harmful conditions remain unchanged.
It follows how money, childhood, workplaces, and institutions enter the causes of distress.
The book’s distinctive question is which conditions cause illness, trigger it, or prolong it.
Readers gain a way to examine social causes alongside biological vulnerability and clinical care.

art.composition: Begin in a quiet clinical encounter with two people at equal eye level, no medical props suggesting a prescribed treatment. Widen toward the same worker’s daily life: a phone receives a shift change beside an interrupted rest setting. This is an authored illustration of the book’s example, not an identifiable patient or a claimed clinical result.
actionByLine: The clinician listens while the worker explains; a restrained face/gaze change shows being heard, not a cure.
The view opens toward a phone and workplace schedule linked to the person’s disrupted day. Avoid a row of money/child/work icons.
The same shift keeps moving on the visible schedule, so the problem continues beyond the consultation.
Keep clinical support and the external exposure both visible, without showing one replace or cancel the other.
art.emotion: Recognition of suffering → attention to context → constructive curiosity.

scenes.title: What changed with income
lines: The opening follows a study of children in western North Carolina.
Casino profits funded annual payments to members of the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians.
Some previously poor families crossed the poverty line after those payments began.
Children in those families showed fewer conduct and oppositional defiant symptoms.
Anxiety and depression did not show the same improvement in that study.
Earlier assessments let researchers compare each group before and after the income change.
The book uses that selective result to ask which pathways money actually changes.

art.composition: A family income-and-study sequence uses a normal lived-in home, an annual tribal payment entering the household, and the already-existing longitudinal study record. No casino glamour, gambling behavior, caricatured Indigenous dress, invented currency amount, numerical effect size, or child magically cured by money.
actionByLine: Establish a researcher’s ongoing child/family observation alongside the domestic setting; the study exists before the income event.
An annual payment arrives from tribal profit distribution; show a neutral payment document and household receipt, not gambling winnings.
A recurring household resource changes while the existing observation record continues; use the spoken poverty-line distinction, no invented before/after bank balance.

A qualitative observed-outcome record identifies conduct and oppositional symptoms as improving among the families who escaped poverty. Do not turn this into a claim about every child or every disorder.
The separate anxiety/depression outcome remains explicitly without the same improvement; keep both records visible so selectivity is substantive.
Move back along the already-visible study history to the pre-payment observations and forward again, showing why timing matters. No randomized-assignment illustration.
Return to the family and the causal question rather than a universal cash-cure slogan.
art.emotion: Discovery → hopeful evidence → precise surprise at the selective result → inquiry.

scenes.title: Repair more than the response
lines: In another example, panic begins after a supervisor makes shifts unpredictable and humiliates workers.
The clinic can offer care, while the same workplace keeps recreating exposure.
The book asks what the employer controls: schedules, workload, voice, and safe reporting.
It proposes immediate clinical help alongside changes to conditions that sustain harmful exposure.
The task is to reduce harmful exposure while helping the person now.

art.composition: Return to the worker, now at an actual shift board and reporting interaction. The old schedule is repeatedly overwritten while another manager or representative can receive a concern. A brief return to the clinical setting shows help continuing. No toggles, levers labelled Environment, or medical recommendations.
actionByLine: A shift replacement arrives while the worker is preparing to rest; posture reacts to the interruption. Humiliation remains in narration without an invented abusive quote or sensational threat.
Revisit the calm clinical exchange while the schedule still changes elsewhere.
Show an employer-controlled scheduling practice and an accessible reporting conversation as concrete changeable arrangements.
A proposed schedule becomes stable and a concern is heard; keep this explicitly a proposed environmental repair, not a measured intervention result.
Hold the two real activities—care and reducing exposure—without a cure transformation or a forced happy ending.
art.emotion: Frustration → recognition of agency → restrained constructive possibility.

scenes.title: Read the argument against itself
lines: The argument also faces genetic vulnerability, reverse causation, and uneven intervention results.
Mental illness can itself damage employment, income, housing, and relationships.
That feedback means a system can prolong suffering it did not originally cause.
Begin with the casino study, then read The Case Against This Book.
Read it to distinguish treating distress from changing the conditions that keep renewing it.

art.composition: A person’s disrupted work and household routine can now be seen in the opposite causal direction: an existing difficult episode makes participation harder, which then creates new obstacles. End at an actual reading moment returning to the casino study and counterargument chapter, preserving the person’s dignity rather than turning them into a diagnostic icon.
actionByLine: Pause before the source’s counterarguments; avoid decorative DNA/brain icons or a claims-of-certainty badge.
An already-struggling person misses a work obligation and then faces a practical income or appointment difficulty; do not imply laziness or make a specific diagnosis.
Show the practical obstacle arriving back into the person’s daily routine, so a consequence can become a maintaining condition.
An open reading spread points to the actual prologue and counterargument chapter; source titles are object-level navigation rather than duplicate scene slogans.
Finish on the reader following the same person’s whole situation, with the clinical relationship retained.
art.emotion: Intellectual challenge → empathy → clearer causal understanding → reading invitation.

No machines literally manufacturing illness, generic brain/DNA symbols, decorative before/after cards or cure transformations.
visualAcceptance: Preserve selective outcomes exactly: children in families that escaped poverty, conduct/oppositional symptoms, no equivalent anxiety/depression improvement.
Do not imply the income study was randomized or that payments were gambling winnings.
Clinical care remains present and useful; no delay/withdrawal of treatment is advocated.
Proposed workplace repair is not shown as a measured clinical result.
Preserve one short scene heading, meaningful legible object labels and caption-safe motion in all themes.
